dateline: BTS completed two sold-out nights at Bogotá's El Campín (Oct 2-3), their first-ever Colombia shows, opening the ARIRANG World Tour's South American leg.
heroHeadline: Day 4,861: BTS Make Colombia Debut at El Campín to Open Latin American Leg
heroSubtitle: October 4, 2026 is Day 4,861 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS played their first Colombian concert on Oct 2 at Bogotá's El Campín, a 23-song set reported at 35,000 to 45,000 fans, with a second night on Oct 3. The ARIRANG World Tour continues to Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo.
